title: Define and enforce true submodule mode semantics for child memory repos
description: Audit cluster from F-005: submodule mode writes .gitmodules metadata but may not create or verify a real Git submodule gitlink.
acceptanceCriteria: Boreal either creates and verifies a real gitlink for submodule mode or renames the mode to match actual behavior.
Doctor distinguishes metadata-only .gitmodules state from a real Git submodule.
Setup and doctor docs explain the exact expected Git state for submodule mode.
closedReason: Implemented and verified in sprint bw_work_30c5438d99da6ce6.
